protocol: Known-item judged set. Each target is one chunk of the reference corpus, identified by a verbatim snippet so it can be re-resolved after re-ingestion, and each query is judged relevant to exactly that target chunk. A single-target judgment measures findability of a designated passage, not exhaustive recall; the harness reports document-level success separately so a chunk-level miss is not confused with a document-level one.
